{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter to only SEVERE disease patients
severe_df = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Check that -999 values are present in the SEVERE subset
n_neg999_severe = (severe_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 in baseline for SEVERE patients: {n_neg999_severe}")

# Filter out the QC-failed rows
severe_valid = severe_df[severe_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Check the number of valid patients
print(f"Number of valid SEVERE patients (non -999 baseline): {len(severe_valid)}")

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker
mean_baseline = severe_valid['biomarker_baseline'].mean()
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker (ng/mL) for SEVERE patients: {mean_baseline}")"}
